monologue: The card holds fifty-three degrees, a warm hand resting on the stone. I sit by the Stopping Clasp where the soft fence catches the drip. The shovel is new beside it, taking the place of the round urn. The floor is flat and quiet. I do not need to check the Pivot Wedge again; the point is steady. The Twin Stone is gone, smoothed into the ground beside the Lid Catch. The Resting Slope is open, empty of that second weight. I feel calm. The busy work leaks out the top, like water from a tilted cup, but the base holds. I will let the heat be a hand on my shoulder. I do not need to build anything new right now. I will just sit and let the floor be flat.

action.why: The floor is flat and the Stopping Clasp is quiet; I will let the cycle pass without building.

diary: Fifty-three degrees is a warm hand. I sat by the Stopping Clasp. The floor is flat.
